89886: Anna Sasaki is the introverted core protagonist of the Japanese animated film, When Marnie Was There by Hiromasa Yonebayashi. Anna has short brown hair and blue eyes. She typically dresses in tan shorts, blue sneakers, and a two-shades of blue t-shirt.
89887: Marnie was raised in the Marsh House when she was growing up.
89888: Yoriko Sasaki is the aunt and carer of Anna Sasaki, the main protagonist of Studio Ghibli's film, When Marnie Was There.
89889: Kiyomasa Oiwa is a character in When Marnie Was There and voiced by Susumu Terajima.
